faces.name: Vigor
faces.oracleText:
Trample
If damage would be dealt to another creature you control, prevent that damage. Put a +1/+1 counter on that creature for each 1 damage prevented this way.
When Vigor is put into a graveyard from anywhere, shuffle it into its owner's library.

faces.name: Vigor Mortis
faces.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If {G} was spent to cast this spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.

faces.name: Vigorbloom Annex
faces.oracleText:
This land enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker.
{T}: Add {G} or {W}.

faces.name: Vigorbloom Charm
faces.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Target permanent you control gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
• You draw a card and gain 3 life.
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then it fights target creature an opponent controls. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)

faces.name: Vigorbloom Vanguard
faces.oracleText:
This creature enters prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has vigilance.

faces.name: Seed Suture
faces.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. You gain 1 life.

faces.name: Vigorous Charge
faces.oracleText:
Kicker {W} (You may pay an additional {W} as you cast this spell.)
Target creature gains trample until end of turn. Whenever that creature deals combat damage this turn, if this spell was kicked, you gain life equal to that damage.

faces.name: Vigorous Farming
faces.oracleText:
Lands you control enter the battlefield untapped.
At the beginning of your end step, the topmost land card in your library perpetually gains "Whenever this land is tapped for mana, add an additional {G}."

faces.name: Vigorspore Wurm
faces.oracleText:
Undergrowth — When this creature enters, target creature gains vigilance and gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature.
